group.voxels.help: The walls you crash into, and the voxel grid that shows them.
group.crash.help: What happens when you hit something, and how you get back in the air.
group.camera.help: The FPV camera of each drone. A change shows at once and never moves the drone.
group.display.help: What the screen shows, the picture quality and the language.
group.input.help: Your radio, gamepad or keyboard. Calibration is on the Controls screen.
group.drone.help: The drone you fly and how it flies: gravity, motors, drag. Most values are kept for each drone separately.
group.tune.help: PID, rates and throttle curve of each drone, as in Betaflight.
group.scenes.help: Which scans come next and how they are picked.
